bear_case.summary: AppLovin's growth is real: Q2 2026 revenue rose 53% YoY. But the SEC described a probe tied to alleged data and contract practices as 'active and ongoing' in Feb 2026, and the business depends on app-store/OS platform rules. SBC nearly doubled YoY. The stock is down 61% from its high, which suggests the market prices a real regulatory or platform tail risk.

risks.risk: SEC enforcement or platform-partner action over data/targeting practices
risks.early_warning_signal: Wells notice or 8-K; 10-Q legal note; Apple/Google policy changes

risks.risk: Platform dependency (Apple ATT, Google Privacy Sandbox on Android)
Growth deceleration from a high base, plus e-commerce advertiser churn

accounting_red_flags.receivables_vs_revenue: AR +19% in 6 months (1.82B to 2.17B) vs Q2 revenue +53% YoY: not alarming
accounting_red_flags.one_time_items: Apps business sold (discontinued ops); comparisons are distorted

value_trap: An 18x forward P/E looks cheap for 50% growth only if earnings are durable. A regulatory finding against its data practices would impair the moat itself, not just one year of earnings.
